description: This file contains comprehensive unit tests for the PdfSharp and MigraDoc libraries, focusing on security features such as encryption, decryption, permissions, passwords, and digital signatures within PDF documents. It includes tests for writing and reading documents with various security options, embedded files handling under encryption, string encryption checks, hyperlink functionality, and digital signatures with certificates.

classes.name: SecurityTests
classes.description: A suite of unit tests for verifying PDF security features, including encryption, decryption, permissions, embedded files, string encryption, hyperlinks, and digital signatures within PDF documents.

methods.name: OpenPdf
methods.description: Utility method to open a PDF file using the default system viewer for manual inspection.

methods.name: Test_Write_NoPassword
methods.description: Test to write a PDF document without any encryption and open it for verification.

methods.name: Test_Read_NoPassword
methods.description: Test to read a PDF document that was written without encryption and then re-save it.

methods.name: Test_Write_UserPassword
methods.description: Test to write a secured PDF with a user password and verify accessibility.

methods.name: Test_Read_UserPassword_Without_Fails
methods.description: Test to ensure that opening a PDF with the correct user password succeeds.

methods.name: Test_Read_UserPassword_Wrong_Fails
methods.description: Test to verify that opening with an incorrect user password fails as expected.

methods.name: Test_Read_UserPassword
methods.description: Test to open a PDF with the correct user password and then save it.

methods.name: Test_Write_OwnerPassword
methods.description: Test to write a PDF secured with an owner password.

methods.name: Test_Read_OwnerPassword_Without_Fails
methods.description: Test to verify that opening a PDF with the owner password succeeds.

methods.name: Test_Read_OwnerPassword_Wrong_Fails
methods.description: Test to ensure that opening an encrypted PDF with a wrong owner password fails.

methods.name: Test_Read_OwnerPassword
methods.description: Test to open a PDF with the correct owner password and save it.

methods.name: Test_Write_UserAndOwnerPassword
methods.description: Test to write a PDF secured with both user and owner passwords.

methods.name: Test_Read_UserAndOwnerPassword_Without_Fails
methods.description: Test to verify that opening with both correct passwords fails if passwords are missing.

methods.name: Test_Read_UserAndOwnerPassword_Wrong_Fails
methods.description: Test to verify failure on wrong combined passwords.

methods.name: Test_Read_UserAndOwnerPassword_User
methods.description: Test to open a PDF with the user password only and verify failure.

methods.name: Test_Read_UserAndOwnerPassword_User_Fails
methods.description: Test ensuring failure with password missing or incorrect.

methods.name: Test_Read_UserAndOwnerPassword_Owner
methods.description: Test to open a PDF with the owner password only.

methods.name: Test_EmbeddedFile_WrapperEncrypted
methods.description: Test to embed an unencrypted file into an encrypted PDF.

methods.name: Test_EmbeddedFile_EmbEncrypted
methods.description: Test to embed an encrypted file into a non-encrypted PDF.

methods.name: Test_EmbeddedFile_BothEncrypted
methods.description: Test to embed an encrypted file in an encrypted parent document.

methods.name: Test_EmbeddedFile_OnlyEmbeddedFileStreamsEncrypted
methods.description: Test encrypts only embedded file streams within an encrypted PDF.

methods.name: Test_Permissions
methods.description: Test setting various permission flags on PDF security settings and verifying enforcement.

methods.name: Test_Strings
methods.description: Complex test encrypting/decrypting various strings, including Unicode, and verifying content and encoding integrity.

methods.name: Test_Hyperlink
methods.description: Test creating a PDF with a hyperlink and saving it.

methods.name: Test_SignedDocument
methods.description: Test creating, signing, and verifying digitally signed PDF documents with encryption and certificates.

methods.name: CreateDocument
methods.description: Helper method to create a minimalistic MigraDoc document with signatures.

methods.name: GetCertificate
methods.description: Helper to load a X509 certificate from a file for signing.
